description: Track context usage as a percentage and safely continue long tasks in fresh threads. A meter above the chat input shows how full the context window is: it uses your theme's main color below 20% (light gray in dark mode), then turns yellow at 20%, orange at 30%, red at 40% and dark red at 65%. Each thread has an Auto handoff switch, off until you turn it on. Turn it on below 20% and the thread hands off once it reaches 30%; turn it on at 20% or above and it hands off at the next safe stopping point. The agent saves its plan and progress as notes, and a fresh thread confirms it read them, then continues with the switch on. Turning the switch off cancels a pending handoff.
